description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for the LocationService component of the OrangeHRM system, specifically testing location-related functionalities within the admin plugin. It sets up mock dependencies, loads test data, and verifies methods like retrieving locations by ID, searching locations, counting search results, and fetching related data, as well as testing access control aspects.

classes.name: LocationServiceTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing the LocationService related functionalities within the OrangeHRM admin plugin.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, sets up mock services, loads test data, and prepares the LocationService instance.

methods.name: testGetLocationById
methods.description: Verifies that getLocationById in LocationService correctly retrieves a Location object by ID.

methods.name: testSearchLocations
methods.description: Checks that searchLocations returns the correct list of Location objects based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: testGetSearchLocationListCount
methods.description: Ensures getSearchLocationListCount returns the correct count of locations matching the search filter.

methods.name: testGetNumberOfEmployeesForLocation
methods.description: Verifies that getNumberOfEmployeesForLocation returns the expected number of employees for a specific location.

methods.name: testGetLocationIdsForEmployees
methods.description: Checks that getLocationIdsForEmployees returns the correct list of location IDs for a given list of employee numbers.

methods.name: testGetAccessibleLocationsArray
methods.description: Tests that getAccessibleLocationsArray returns an array of locations, even if empty, for both default and specific access levels.
